page.layout: One page of running text, no marginal notes and no block below the text. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right.

main_text.l: mini manet in æternum, die forcht des Herren ist der
weisheit anfang/timor Domini est sapientiæ initiu.
Substantivum regit etiam infinitum cum Adverbio
zu: ut, zeit zusagen/ tempus dicendi, fursatz recht zu
thun/propositum recte faciendi.
Substantivum regit Substantivum in Genitivo cū
adjectivo descriptionis: ut, ein weib schöner gestalt/
fœmina speciosi vultus. Interdum additur uon[?]: ut,
ein knab von guter art/ puer bonæ indolis.
Adjectivum & Substantivum eodem numero, ge-
nere & casu cohærent: ut, ein frommer mann/ probus vir, ein fromme frawe/ proba fœmina.
Nomen Gott/ Deus, nomen proprium viri, mulieris, urbis, & nomen ejus rei, quæ terra nascitur,&
quæ mensuratur ac ponderatur, Substantivum post
Genitivum, & pronomina, absq; Articulis fere usur-pantur.
Relativum cum antecedente Substantivo necesse
est numero & genere consentire: ut, der bötte/

l.bl: welchen du zu mir gesandt hast/ ist auff der reise vmb-

main_text.l: bracht/ Tabellarius, quem ad me misisti, est in itine-
re interfectus. Relativi loco est particula so vel da
von: ut, alle/ so in Christum glauben/ werden nit
zu schanden/omnes, qui in Christum credunt, non con-
funduntur. Ich sende dir das buch/ da von du mir
schreibest/ mitto tibi librum, de quo mihi scribebas.
Adjectivum partitivum regit Genitivum plura-
lem: ut, der bürger einer/civium unus.
Adjectivum copiæ, inopiæ, vel memoriæ regit Ge-
nitivum: ut, sie sind vol süsses weins/ sunt pleni

page.notes: Black letter (Fraktur) words inside the roman text are marked with bl; the exact type of some German words (e.g. "ist der", "anfang", "schöner", "gestalt", "guter art") is only probably black letter. The word after "Interdum additur" reads "uon" with a doubtful mark, transcribed as uon[?]. The "zu" before "Substantivum regit etiam" and in the line "zu mir" is printed with a z-like long character, transcribed as zu. "zeit" in "jeit zusagen" is doubtful as to its first letter. "süsses" in the last line is uncertain (the umlaut and double s). The catchword and signature are not printed on this page. No marginal notes or footnotes are printed.
